faqs.question: How long must I use this pack to see results?
faqs.answer: You will notice visible reduction in skin texture with 2-3 months of use. With KP or strawberry skin: changes depend on the severity of the condition. However, it is advisable to speak to an expert first.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of this pack?
faqs.answer: There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you to do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time.

faqs.question: What else can I use with this pack?
faqs.answer: You can use your regular spot treatments and sprays along with this kit. However - we don't recommend using retinol and vitamin c based based products on your body when using this kit.

faqs.question: Why should I use this bodywash?
faqs.answer: Enriched with Salicylic Acid - this is a bodywash that does more- it cleanses your pores, prevent acne formation and also helps gently exfoliate skin.

faqs.question: Will the lotion leave my skin sticky?
faqs.answer: No, this lightweight formula absorbs very quickly into the skin. It won't leave your skin sticky.
